description: Defines an abstract class 'pdcch_resource_allocator' for PDCCH resource allocation algorithms in a 4G/5G NR scheduler, including methods for allocating and canceling PDCCH resources for common and UE-specific use cases.

classes.name: pdcch_resource_allocator
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for PDCCH resource allocation algorithms, including methods for common and UE-specific PDCCH allocation and cancellation.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates RE space for common downlink PDCCH, avoiding collisions with other PDCCHs.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates RE space for common uplink PDCCH, avoiding collisions.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates RE space for UE-dedicated downlink PDCCH.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates RE space for UE-dedicated uplink PDCCH.
